title: hdf5read
summary: Legacy alias for reading dense HDF5 datasets.

gpu_support.notes: Uses the same host HDF5 path as `h5read`.

description: `hdf5read(filename, dataset)` is the legacy compatibility name for `h5read` and supports the same dense dataset subset and selection forms.
behaviors: Unsupported HDF5 types raise deterministic unsupported-type errors.
